Grandma was right.

Nobody really believed her. Not even you, her favorite grandchild.

But she was right. And more so than you could ever imagine.

The city before you, deep in the mist shrouded forest, can't be found on any map. It shouldn't even exist. Though it's been asleep for a long time, you feel a mysterious power begin to awaken from the ruins around you.

Legend has it the civilization that built this place could somehow control the seasons. But nobody listens to legends.

Nobody except Grandma.

And she was right.

You look again at the artifact she gave you. Close to this lost city, it almost seems alive in your hand.

The city does exist. It's real.

Could the secret magic, powerful enough to change the seasons, be real too?

Features: 
• Inspired by classic point and click adventure games!
• Beautiful graphics that draw you into this mesmerizing adventure!
• Lots of items to collect and puzzles to solve!
• Original soundtrack and sound effects!
• A journal that keeps track of all the symbols and clues that you encounter.
• A dynamic map that shows all of the areas you have explored, as well as your current location.
• A complete hint guide and walkthrough built right into the game.
• The Lost City has been translated into several languages.
• Available for iPhone, iPod Touch, and iPad!

Are you searching for an adventure that will push your puzzle-solving abilities to the limit? Look no further than Legacy 4: Tomb of Secrets, the ultimate mobile game for those who love a good brain teaser. This game is designed to immerse you in a world of mystery and intrigue, with stunning 3D graphics and physics-based puzzles that will challenge even the most experienced players.

Step into the shoes of a young archaeologist and explore the hidden secrets of an ancient tomb. With an immersive point-and-click interface, you'll be able to interact with your surroundings in a way that feels natural and intuitive. Each room in the tomb presents a new challenge, with puzzles that will test your intelligence, creativity, and problem-solving skills.

But be warned, the tomb is full of surprises, and someone may be watching your every move. Keep an escape plan in mind at all times, and use your wits and instincts to uncover the truth behind the tomb's mysterious past.

As you progress through the game, you'll uncover clues and collect items that will help you piece together the tomb's history and the people who built it. Use your touch controls to inspect objects and take photos of anything that catches your eye, and immerse yourself in the world of the ancient tomb.

What sets Legacy 4 apart from other puzzle games is its innovative hint system. If you find yourself stuck on a puzzle, don't worry. The game's built-in hint system will guide you through the most challenging puzzles, ensuring that you never get stuck for long. And with a range of difficulty levels to choose from, you can customize your experience to match your skill level and preferences.

Whether you're a casual gamer looking for a fun challenge or a seasoned pro searching for the ultimate puzzle game, Legacy 4: Tomb of Secrets is the game for you. Download it now and experience the adventure of a lifetime!
